Name: DLG_ELDER_WREN_GREETING
Lines: Come in out of the dark, friend. Lanternrest is small, but there is always room by the fire.

Name: DLG_BRAM_TALLOW_GREETING
Lines: Welcome, welcome! Mind the barrels. Looking to buy something sturdy, or sell something shiny?

Name: DLG_YSOLDE_THORN_GREETING
Lines: Softly, now. The forest has long ears. Sit by the fire and tell me what you have seen.

Name: DLG_BROTHER_CAEL_GREETING
Lines: Peace be with you. The hills are restless tonight, but the tower is warm and the tea is hot.

Name: DLG_DAWNSTAG_GREETING
Lines: The antlers glow softly, and a warm voice like wind through lanterns speaks in your mind: 'Little light, you have come at last.'

Name: DLG_Q01_OFFER
Lines: Look at the lanterns, traveler. They used to burn all night, and now they sputter before the stars are even out.
The glowmoss in Glimmer Meadow is what feeds them, and it is fading. Would you gather some fresh clumps for me?

Name: DLG_Q02_OFFER
Lines: Those Scrappers have been into my stores again, the cheeky little scoundrels.
Eight of them gone from the meadow would let me sleep at night. What do you say?

Name: DLG_Q03_OFFER
Lines: The Scrappers keep a chest at their camp, and in it lies a shard of the Ember Crown.
It is guarded by four of them. Will you fetch it for Lanternrest?

Name: DLG_Q04_OFFER
Lines: The forest lanterns went dark long ago, and the wisps have grown bold.
Relight four of them for me, and the Hollow will remember the road home.

Name: DLG_Q05_OFFER
Lines: Elder Hask wears a crown shard like a trophy. He is a clever old shaman, so mind his bog bolts.
Bring him down and bring the shard back. Will you do it?

Name: DLG_Q06_OFFER
Lines: I have watched you from the cliffs, little light. You carry the glow with you.
Bring me the two shards and three glowmoss clumps. The wisps will come, so stand guard until the lamp-stones are lit.

Name: DLG_Q07_OFFER
Lines: Do you see the lights on the hillside? Those are hollowed knights, marching their patrol without rest.
Six of them laid to peace would make the hills safer. Will you help me?

Name: DLG_Q08_OFFER
Lines: Gristlehorn the Moss Titan holds the third shard, and he is as dangerous as he looks.
Bring friends if you can. Will you take the hills back from him?

Name: DLG_Q09_OFFER
Lines: All three shards are gathered. The time has come to go beneath the hills.
Take a party into Maldrek's Barrow and end the Hollow King's reign. Are you ready?

Name: DLG_Q01_TURNIN
Lines: You have the glowmoss! Let me see it.
Wonderful. Wonderful! Here, take this with my thanks.

Name: DLG_Q02_TURNIN
Lines: Is it done? The Scrappers are gone from the meadow?
Splendid! A little something for your trouble.

Name: DLG_Q03_TURNIN
Lines: Is that... it is! The first shard!
Warm as a hearth. Thank you, from the bottom of Lanternrest's heart.

Name: DLG_Q04_TURNIN
Lines: I saw the lanterns glow from the ridge. Every one of them.
You are a friend of the forest. Take this.

Name: DLG_Q05_TURNIN
Lines: Hask is down? And the shard?
Two pieces of the crown now. Well done, truly.

Name: DLG_Q06_TURNIN
Lines: The lamp-stones glow again, and the wisps are gone.
You stood your ground, little light. I will carry you now.

Name: DLG_Q07_TURNIN
Lines: They are at rest now, aren't they? I felt it from the tower.
Thank you for your mercy. Please take this.

Name: DLG_Q08_TURNIN
Lines: The third shard! And you are in one piece!
The Vale owes you a great debt. Take this gift.

Name: DLG_Q09_TURNIN
Lines: The crown glows in your hands. Is it over?
Come, let us go up to the square and see what you have done.
